page.overview:
Who is Violet Liddle?

Violet Annabelle Liddle was created by Raven Gregory in 2009, first appearing in issue #1 of the 1st volume of Beyond Wonderland by Zenescope Entertainment.

After Calie Liddle escaped for the first time from Wonderland, she ran away to New York City with her boyfriend Brandon Price while already being pregnant. Violet was eventually born and joined her family's history of a connection to Wonderland, as it influenced her with its madness via the Mad Hatter's hat. Later she fought side by side with her mother, both in Wonderland and on Earth against the forces of the Realm of Nightmares.
